code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    colors={v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,6)}
    marker=next(iter(colors))
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==marker]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); c0=min(j for i,j in pts)
    shape=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); H=max(i for i,j in shape)+1; W=max(j for i,j in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h-H+1):
      for j in range(w-W+1):
        cells=[(i+di,j+dj) for di,dj in shape]
        if all(g[a][b]==0 or g[a][b]==marker for a,b in cells):
          for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=marker
    return out
'''
